chapter: Early life, family and Crescent Orchestra
title: First job on a pleasure boat, playing violin
summary: His first paid job was on a Mississippi excursion boat playing violin in a small string and cornet group.

blocks.x: My first job, speaking about job, playing out. My first job I played out, I remember, with the old man Tom Albert.
When would that have been about?
Was that the first instrument you learned? That's my first instrument.
What was the job? The job was on the, it was on a pleasure boat on the Mississippi River. Excursion? Yeah, pleasure boat ran from, say, Esplanade Street down Chalamet. Down below.
Yeah. What kind of a band did they have? Is it a full six or seven piece band or just a small group?
No, it had violin, outlet violin. He was playing cornette, a guitar, a guitar, a guitar, a guitar, and bass.
